about: Critic (lane C3): the frame rate when my car goes through the market square's stalls, by real input in real time, against the same measure on a plain street. BEGIN at the tail; (a) on Cooper St, W held 4 s; (b) at Cooper x Market St's corner, W held 4 s into the square's stalls (his 'near' way, corner to corner). The square must hold the street's rate (within ~25 %). Today (2026-10-02, the machine shared) the square fell to a few frames a second. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/critic/tail_square_fps.json --size 1440x900 (NOIR_PORT=5343)

steps.name: (a) a plain street: Cooper St going north

steps.eval: window.__a = (() => { const f = window.__fr; const n = f.length; const d = []; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) d.push(f[i] - f[i - 1]); d.sort((a, b) => b - a); return JSON.stringify({ fps: +((n - 1) / ((f[n - 1] - f[0]) / 1000)).toFixed(1), worstMs: d.slice(0, 5).map((x) => +x.toFixed(0)), pieces: G.stage.smash.pieces.length }); })()

steps.name: (b) into the market square's stalls, corner to corner

steps.eval: window.__b = (() => { const f = window.__fr; const n = f.length; const d = []; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) d.push(f[i] - f[i - 1]); d.sort((a, b) => b - a); return JSON.stringify({ fps: +((n - 1) / ((f[n - 1] - f[0]) / 1000)).toFixed(1), worstMs: d.slice(0, 5).map((x) => +x.toFixed(0)), pieces: G.stage.smash.pieces.length }); })()
